notes: Maps exception reason codes to a hold class (R3, PART XVIII). Loaded and validated by plm_platform.exceptions.load_hold_class_policy.
HARD_STOP: no approve or override from any role resumes the case. It resolves only when the external process's evidence is recorded (record_external_resolution).
REVIEWABLE_QUARANTINE: resumes only for an actor holding reviewer_role and only with every required_evidence item. No entry has empty required_evidence, so there is no bare approve anywhere.
A reason code missing from reason_codes is classified by 'unmapped' (HARD_STOP) and flagged on the case.

Citations: AGENTS.md:43; docs/P0_master_integration_implementation_plan.md:66 (human hard-stops); docs/architecture.md:906-921 (P29); docs/reviews/2026-10-13-system-review-and-remediation-plan.md:183-187 (R3 exception queue); docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:1420-1437 (P5 section 49 quarantine semantics).

v4 (R4, ADR-0034): P5 rights detectors and P28 provenance. New codes INCOMPLETE_P28_PROVENANCE, REFERENCE_AUDIO_MATCH, INTERNAL_CATALOG_AUDIO_MATCH, AUDIO_FINGERPRINT_UNKNOWN, LYRIC_SIMILARITY_UNKNOWN; the P29 codes now name their P5 emitter. services/quality_gate/detectors/reason_codes.py lists every code P5 emits as a hold and the P29 category each reports.

v5 (R5): the pipeline no longer reserves budget; a phase's external-write guard is the single reservation and its refusal (409) holds the run. BUDGET_RESERVATION_REFUSED is now raised for a guard's budget reason; new EXTERNAL_WRITE_NOT_AUTHORIZED for a guard's authorization or policy reason; new PLAYLIST_SUPPLY_SHORT when a playlist's cleared supply stays short of its declared minimum after the bounded top-up rounds. A guard reason nobody declared is raised as EXTERNAL_WRITE_REFUSED, deliberately unmapped (hard stop, fail closed).
v6 (R6, D10): new MANUAL_AUDIO_AWAITED when P4 waits for songs the owner makes on suno.com and saves in the import inbox.

unmapped.source: docs/reviews/2026-10-13-system-review-and-remediation-plan.md:185 (fail closed: a code the policy does not classify is never assumed reviewable)
unmapped.description: No policy entry for this reason code. Treated as a hard stop until the policy classifies it.

COPYRIGHT_DISPUTE.description: A copyright dispute is open against a published or submitted asset.

PLATFORM_POLICY_DISPUTE.description: A platform has opened a policy dispute (strike, policy violation notice).

KYC_REQUIRED.description: A provider requires identity verification before it will continue.

ACCOUNT_SECURITY_EVENT.description: An account-security event (suspicious login, credential revocation, lockout) on a provider account.

PAYMENT_METHOD_CHANGE.description: A payment method or payout destination change was requested or detected.

PROTECTED_ARTIST_REFERENCE_DETECTED.source: docs/architecture.md:911 (P29 'artist reference detected'); list in plm_platform/policy/protected_artists.json, shared with P4's prompt builder (refused before generation); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/policy.py on the prompt, genre tags and lyrics
PROTECTED_ARTIST_REFERENCE_DETECTED.description: A prompt or metadata names a protected or living artist.

LYRIC_SIMILARITY_HIGH.source: docs/architecture.md:912 (P29 'copyrighted lyric similarity high'); docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:938-961 (section 30); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/lyrics.py when the shingled similarity detector returns MATCH (ADR-0034)
LYRIC_SIMILARITY_HIGH.description: Lyrics are highly similar to a copyrighted work.

SAMPLE_PROVENANCE_UNCERTAIN.source: docs/architecture.md:913 (P29 'sample provenance uncertain'); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py for a declared source input with no license reference
SAMPLE_PROVENANCE_UNCERTAIN.description: The provenance of a sample in the audio cannot be established.

COMMERCIAL_LICENSE_UNCERTAIN.source: docs/architecture.md:914 (P29 'commercial license uncertain'); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py for a declared conditional or expired_or_unverified license
COMMERCIAL_LICENSE_UNCERTAIN.description: A commercial-use license was declared but its terms are in doubt (conflicting, conditional or contested) and need a determination outside PLM. Distinct from UNKNOWN_COMMERCIAL_LICENSE, where no usable declaration exists yet.

UNAUTHORIZED_VOICE_CLONE_DETECTED.source: docs/architecture.md:915 (P29 'unauthorized voice cloning detected'); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py for a declared voice input (voice_reference, voice_model, voice_sample, vocal_stem) with no authorization reference. There is no acoustic voice-similarity detector (ADR-0034).
UNAUTHORIZED_VOICE_CLONE_DETECTED.description: The vocal imitates a real person without documented authorization.

AI_POLICY_CONFLICT.source: docs/architecture.md:916 (P29 'AI policy conflict'); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/policy.py when the prompt, tags or lyrics request voice cloning or impersonation (ai_policy_conflict_markers in protected_artists.json)
AI_POLICY_CONFLICT.description: The asset conflicts with a platform's or distributor's AI-content policy.

DISTRIBUTOR_REJECTION.source: docs/architecture.md:917 (P29 'distributor rejection'); PART XVIII example at docs/architecture.md:971-977
DISTRIBUTOR_REJECTION.description: The distributor rejected a release; it resumes only on the distributor's recorded decision.

PLATFORM_CLAIM.description: A platform claim (for example a Content ID claim) was raised on a published asset.

UNKNOWN_COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.source: docs/reviews/2026-10-13-system-review-and-remediation-plan.md:187 ('Unknown rights stay quarantined'); docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:1430 ('provider API did not return commercial-use status'); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py
UNKNOWN_COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.description: No usable commercial-use declaration: no rights snapshot, or the provider declared 'unknown'. Unknown rights are reviewable, but the only exit is the license evidence: a bare approve is refused. A declared conditional or expired license is COMMERCIAL_LICENSE_UNCERTAIN instead.

INCOMPLETE_R6_PROVENANCE.description: The provider declared no license terms for the producing attempt. Resumes only with the recovered license terms.

BUDGET_RESERVATION_REFUSED.source: docs/reviews/2026-10-13-system-review-and-remediation-plan.md:184-186 (cost ledger and ceiling: fail closed when the ceiling is exhausted); docs/adr/0033-platform-ops-schema.md (one program ceiling in ops); raised by plm_platform.pipeline.workflow when a phase's external-write guard (P4 music.generate, P7 youtube.upload, P8 distribution.submit) refuses a write for a budget reason (R5: the guard is the single reservation)
BUDGET_RESERVATION_REFUSED.description: A phase's write guard could not fund a paid write (generation, upload, distribution submission): ceiling exhausted, no covering ceiling, no rate for an unpriced write, a currency without an FX rate, or no ledger configured. The write is never made. Reviewable, not a hard stop: the ceiling is PLM's own operator control, not an external dispute, KYC, account-security or payment-method event, and it is cleared by an operator act inside PLM. The budget owner resumes only with the reference of the ceiling or rate-card change that funds the write and the approval behind it; the workflow then retries the step and the guard reserves again against the new headroom, so a resume never bypasses the ledger.

SEVERE_CLIPPING_DETECTED.source: docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:1434 ('technical issue may be repairable'); emitted (blocking, policy p5-audio-qa-v1) by services/quality_gate/evaluators/technical.py
SEVERE_CLIPPING_DETECTED.description: A run of full-scale samples at or above the declared clipping threshold (quality_gate/audio/audio_qa_policy.json). It blocks; a quality reviewer may clear it with a recorded listening review.

CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.source: AGENTS.md:33 ('A missing required fact can never become a passing decision'); docs/reviews/2026-10-13-system-review-and-remediation-plan.md (R4/R5 own the missing pipeline steps)
CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.description: A pipeline step has no implementation yet (the owning stage is named in the case). No approval can produce the missing work; the case closes only when the capability ships and the step is re-run.

INCOMPLETE_P28_PROVENANCE.source: docs/architecture.md:883-901 (P28: twelve fields stored for every asset); docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:1429 ('license evidence missing' is a quarantine); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py (validate_p28_provenance)
INCOMPLETE_P28_PROVENANCE.description: A P28 field other than the rights-snapshot ones (model_version, generation_timestamp, source_inputs, human_contribution, or a C4 fact) was not declared. Never defaulted. Resumes only with the producing attempt and the recovered provenance record.

REFERENCE_AUDIO_MATCH.source: docs/architecture.md:913 (P29 'sample provenance uncertain'); docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:1196-1215 (section 40, near-duplicate detection); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py when the audio fingerprint matches the configured reference set (ADR-0034)
REFERENCE_AUDIO_MATCH.description: The audio re-uses a reference recording (fingerprint MATCH). A risk signal, not a legal conclusion: rights counsel decides outside PLM.

INTERNAL_CATALOG_AUDIO_MATCH.source: docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:161-163 (section 4.2, repetitive or mass-produced content) and 1196-1215 (section 40); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py when the audio fingerprint matches a candidate P5 already released (ADR-0034)
INTERNAL_CATALOG_AUDIO_MATCH.description: The audio duplicates a track already in PLM's own released catalog. PLM owns both, so this is not a third-party rights dispute: a rights reviewer may clear an intended re-release with the match review and the justification.

AUDIO_FINGERPRINT_UNKNOWN.source: docs/reviews/2026-10-13-system-review-and-remediation-plan.md R4 ('A detector that is unavailable or inconclusive returns UNKNOWN, which routes to quarantine. It is never treated as clearance'); docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:1420-1437 (section 49: quarantine, re-evaluable); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/rights.py
AUDIO_FINGERPRINT_UNKNOWN.description: The audio fingerprint check could not conclude: reference set or catalog not configured or unreadable, an empty reference set, unreadable audio, a fingerprint-version mismatch, or too little signal. Never clearance. A rights reviewer resumes only with the similarity review done instead and the reference set it was checked against; re-evaluating once the detector can run is the normal exit.

LYRIC_SIMILARITY_UNKNOWN.source: docs/reviews/2026-10-13-system-review-and-remediation-plan.md R4 (UNKNOWN routes to quarantine, never clearance); docs/P5_quality_rights_provenance_release_gate_implementation_plan.md:1420-1437 (section 49); emitted by services/quality_gate/evaluators/lyrics.py
LYRIC_SIMILARITY_UNKNOWN.description: The lyric similarity check could not conclude: corpus not configured, unreadable or empty, a corpus-version mismatch, lyrics too short to judge, or a vocal track whose lyric text P5 was not given. Never clearance. Resumes only with a similarity review and the corpus it was checked against.

EXTERNAL_WRITE_NOT_AUTHORIZED.source: packages/plm_platform/execution.py (ExternalWriteGuard: a live write needs a LIVE execution policy and an explicit operator authorization record, never inferred from configuration or ProviderMode.REAL); AGENTS.md section 3 ('External side effects go through the guard'); raised by plm_platform.pipeline.workflow when a phase's guard refuses for no_authorization, authorization_expired, policy_read_only, policy_dry_run, policy_shadow or missing_idempotency_key (R5)
EXTERNAL_WRITE_NOT_AUTHORIZED.description: A phase's write guard did not permit a real write because the capability has no valid operator authorization or its execution policy is not live; nothing was written. Reviewable, not a hard stop: granting a write authorization and setting the policy are operator acts inside PLM, not one of the P0 human hard stops (copyright or platform dispute, KYC, account security, payment change, P29). The platform owner resumes only with the authorization record and the policy change; the workflow then retries the step and the guard decides again, so a resume never bypasses the guard.

PLAYLIST_SUPPLY_SHORT.source: docs/STATUS.md 'Playlist duration feasibility' (owner decision 2026-10-15: the playlist length is a declared range, 45-75 min for 45_75m, and a short supply holds and generates more rather than publishing short); AGENTS.md section 3 ('A missing required fact can never become a passing decision'); raised by plm_platform.pipeline.workflow after PipelineOptions.max_topup_rounds top-ups, or when P3 refuses to extend a package past its declared max_extension_track_count (R5)
PLAYLIST_SUPPLY_SHORT.description: The recordings P5 cleared for a playlist still do not reach the minimum of its declared duration range after the bounded top-up rounds (or P3's extension bound was reached). Nothing is published short. Reviewable, not a hard stop: it is PLM's own production capacity, not an external dispute, KYC, account-security, payment or P29 event, and an operator decision inside PLM resolves it. The production owner resumes only with the supply review (why the candidates were rejected or short) and the authorization to spend on more generation; the workflow then runs the same bounded number of top-up rounds again, each through the generation write guard.

MANUAL_AUDIO_AWAITED.source: docs/plans/2026-10-30-r6-real-suno-plan.md (D10: Suno's terms bar automated access, so the owner makes the songs in Suno's interface and PLM imports the downloads); raised by plm_platform.pipeline.workflow when P4 answers manual_audio_awaited (services/music_factory/providers/suno_manual.py)
MANUAL_AUDIO_AWAITED.description: P4 wrote the prompts of the songs it needs into the Suno import inbox and is waiting for the owner's WAV downloads (and lyrics for vocal tracks); nothing was imported. Reviewable, not a hard stop: making the songs is the owner's own production work. The production owner resumes once the files are saved, citing the inbox; the workflow then retries the step and P4 checks every file again before importing any.
